body:
Residual of #867 (`fix/867-nitrogen`); red-team r1 confirmed R1-R5, and R6 was found while drafting.

Tier: **DECISION**.
- GhanaLSS `plot_inputs` records only `Fertilizer` (1,091 rows, all with a quantity).
- No product means no cited share, so `nitrogen_kg(GhanaLSS)` is empty: 0 matched of 11,282 rows. It is named as a gap in `NutrientCoverageWarning`.
- Decide either a documented refusal like the organic one (stays loud), or a nominal "inorganic fertilizer" class share with a citation, as Uganda's class vocabulary has.
- Check first what the quantity measures (unit and kind) in `GhanaLSS/_/CONTENTS.org`.
title: GhanaLSS `Fertilizer` (1,091 rows with a quantity) has no product identity, so it gets no N share
